text:
Nina (PM): Quick internal heads-up: /v3/realtime is GA for hosted today. Tool-Calling v3 + ordered structured frames included. GA models: ember-x (low-latency) and ember-s (cost-optimized). Docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/realtime-ga :tada:

Theo (Eng): Nice. Any breaking wire changes clients should expect?

Nina (PM): Yes: new chunk framing and explicit tool call frames. SDKs must be bumped to >=1.13.0. We provide a 14-day compatibility shim for critical customers only.

deploy-bot: rollout started -> canary(us-east-1) -> gradual progression. CI green.

Rosa (SRE): Ops notes: new metric realtime.conn_p50 added. Fallback policy is now route->ember-s when ember-x breaches latency SLO. If you see 429 spikes during rollout, set REALTIME_THROTTLE_GRACE=true. Alerting: >2.5% error-rate for 5m -> P1 in #incidents.

Theo (Eng): Quick WebSocket snippet for docs: 
```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v3/realtime?model=ember-x', {headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`}});
ws.onmessage = e => console.log(JSON.parse(e.data));
ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'input', text:'Summarize the changelog'}));
```

Ben (Docs): I'll push the migration guide, sample tool-call walkthrough, and a small FAQ on compatibility shims. Link will go to docs site in ~30m.

Nina (PM): Deprecation timeline: new v2 realtime sessions are blocked immediately; full v2 shutdown planned 2026-11-01. Action items: Eng -> publish SDK release, Docs -> migration guide + examples, SRE -> monitor canary dashboards. Ping me for customer exceptions. :rocket:
